dedupe_keys.name: esa worldcereal harmonized reference data repository land cover crop type and irrigation

description: This is the open, community-based repository of harmonized reference data built in the ESA WorldCereal project to train and validate global cropland and crop type maps. The Zenodo record says it gathers field surveys, farmer parcel declarations, image interpretation and high-quality maps from 2017 onward, all harmonized with the same attributes for land cover, crop type, irrigation and validity time, grouped by year and continent in zip archives with a naming convention document and an Excel metadata file. Version 1.1.0 was published in February 2026 by Wageningen University & Research, IIASA and partners, free to download (about 78 GB in 49 files); the 2023 version was split into three records by licence (CC BY, CC BY-SA and CC BY-NC). Coverage is global. Caveats: each dataset keeps its original licence, so users must check it before use or redistribution, and European archives are about 12 GB each. For simulation it gives labelled crop and irrigation samples to build and check crop maps that define agricultural exposure to drought, flood and heat. Related catalogue records include the WorldCereal street imagery validation set and the GEOGLAM best available crop type masks.
licence: mixed per dataset (CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0 or CC BY-NC 4.0)
